name: git
description: Git helpers: a fast add-all-and-commit flow, a guided merge with conflict repair and worktree cleanup, and idempotent per-spec worktree entry. Changelog (last 3): 1.13.0 — The merge command now derives its merge strategy from merge-back inspect and offers it as the recommended default in one question, rather than stopping to ask for a strategy with no guidance. 1.12.0 — Commit scans the files it is about to stage for secrets (spec-paths secrets-scan) and asks before staging any hit — excluding them is the recommended default; secrets never stage silently. 1.11.0 — Commit's step 3 writes the escape row itself for a fix commit that touches spec-landed lines (one row per commit through escape-row.js --append; the defect class is the only question) and keeps the stage:"fix" row for commits no spec landed.
